name: Packaging Products
old_description: Today’s leading minority provider of quality foam products. Count on us for competitive pricing, ISO 9001:2015 certification, ability to hold tight tolerances and outstanding product knowledge.
about:
Packaging Products operates from Plymouth, Michigan. The company has been in business for over three decades and is certified as a minority-owned enterprise by the National Minority Supplier Development Council. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The company supplies and fabricates foam materials including cross-linked polyethylene, polyethylene, polyurethane, rubber, and Arplank. Its capabilities encompass lamination, slitting, sawing, skiving, pressure-sensitive adhesive application, sheeting, die cutting, water jet cutting, and gasket fabrication. A precision skiver is highlighted as a key piece of equipment. The product line includes foam buns, rolls, planks, sheets, and skins. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Customers span automotive, aerospace, U.S. military, and medical supply sectors. The firm cites names in these industries as relying on its custom foam solutions for applications such as dunnage racks, vibration damping, and protective packaging.

Packaging Products emphasizes competitive pricing, ISO 9001:2015 certification, the ability to hold tight tolerances, and deep product knowledge as its differentiators. It positions itself as a source for innovative, custom-fit foam solutions.

about:
Packaging Services Corp., headquartered in Detroit, Michigan, traces its roots to the early 1960s when it entered the retail packaging industry. Over more than five decades, the company expanded its reach, adding sales offices and distribution centers in New Orleans, Louisiana, and Los Angeles, California, to establish a national footprint. In 2017, the firm joined forces with S. Walter, a move that led to its current operation as S.W. Packaging.

The company supplies retail packaging products and services, including a stock product line, custom design services, warehousing, and an online ordering platform. It functions primarily as a distributor and service provider, managing inventory and logistics for clients rather than manufacturing packaging materials itself.

Its customer base spans retail businesses and local communities across the United States, served through its national distribution network. The firm emphasizes continuity of service for its existing clientele while broadening its offering through the S. Walter partnership.

The 2017 partnership with S. Walter expanded the firm’s capabilities beyond its traditional service model, adding creative design, warehousing logistics, and e-commerce ordering to its established distribution network. The company states its focus remains on quality service and products for local communities.

name: PackagingDot
old_description: Create high-quality custom packaging solutions that combine style, quality, and value with ease.
about:
PackagingDot operates from Berryville, Virginia, where it was founded in 2009 by Sami Ullah, who serves as CEO. The company began as a printing service provider and has since expanded into full-service custom packaging.

The company produces custom boxes and packaging using materials such as cardboard, corrugated board, kraft paper, and eco-friendly substrates. Its capabilities include offset printing with a minimum run of 100 units, soft matte coatings (single- or double-sided), and a 360° process covering consultation, design, customization, approval, quality control, and delivery. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

PackagingDot serves a range of B2B clients across industries including cosmetics, candles, soaps, jewelry, CBD products, food packaging (mylar bags), electronics, and child-resistant packaging. Customers cited in reviews include a holistic skincare brand (Barnes Hill) and a natural soap business.

The company states its mission is to redefine printing excellence through innovative, high-quality solutions that exceed expectations while fostering environmental responsibility. Its 360° approach and low minimum order quantities are positioned as key differentiators.

name: Packet Digital
old_description: Building Smarter Batteries and Power Products in the United States
about:
Packet Digital is based in Fargo, North Dakota. Founded in 2003, the company began as a developer of power-saving computer chips before expanding into wireless tracking systems for agriculture and logistics. The founders are not named in the source material.

Today the company designs, manufactures, assembles, and tests smart batteries and power systems for unmanned aerial systems (UAS). Operations span a 25,000-square-foot battery pack manufacturing and assembly facility equipped with a surface-mount technology line, laser welders, and thermal chambers, plus an 80,000-square-foot battery cell manufacturing campus under the Badland Batteries subsidiary that broke ground in 2024. The firm has produced runs such as 10,000 printed circuit boards for an agricultural technology customer.

Customers include the U.S. Marines, U.S. Navy, Air Force Research Laboratory, and commercial UAS platforms worldwide. The company also serves the space sector with power components for CubeSats and the agriculture technology sector through partners like 701x, which uses GPS-enabled smart ear tags for cattle management.

Packet Digital emphasizes U.S.-based production, claiming the first battery factory in North Dakota and the first in the United States to manufacture cells specifically for drones and unmanned systems. Its smart batteries integrate real-time monitoring of state of charge, cell temperature, and fault reporting to extend flight time and improve safety. The company holds CMMC Level 2 certification for defense work.

name: Palm Beach Woodwork Co Inc
old_description: We’re a family-owned organization with a passion for producing high quality architectural woodwork through combined leadership and management for over 80 years.
about:
Palm Beach Woodwork Company, Inc. was founded in 1934 in West Palm Beach, Florida. The family-owned business has operated continuously for over 80 years, establishing itself as a south Florida institution with local, national, and international reach.

The company operates one of the most diverse millwork facilities in the Palm Beach area, producing custom architectural woodwork, custom mouldings, and custom doors. Its capabilities include matching existing moulding profiles or creating new profiles in any wood species, manufacturing entry doors that meet hurricane ratings and high-end grading systems, and supplying specialty lumber such as North American hardwoods and reclaimed barnwood. The firm also provides architectural woodwork installation, estimating, project management, and CAD drafting services.

Palm Beach Woodwork serves the high-end professional building trade and discerning homeowners. Its client base spans residential and commercial projects, with experience in local, national, and international markets.

The company states its mission is to make customers "raving fans through teamwork," emphasizing integrity, client satisfaction, passion, performance, and going the extra mile. It aims to be the woodworking company of choice by offering combined leadership and management expertise.

name: Palmer Foodservice
old_description: Experience three generations of Foodservice and Product Distribution
about:
Palmer Foodservice, a family-owned and operated full-line foodservice distributor, has been based in Shelbyville, Tennessee since its founding in 1948 by Jack Palmer Sr. The company remains under the stewardship of the Palmer family, with Jack and Annette Palmer, Mac and Mary Carol Palmer, and Jack Palmer, Mary Carol Palmer, and Liza Palmer Gipson involved in leadership.

The distributor operates a state-of-the-art facility featuring a wireless warehouse management system with barcode scanning and voice selection, temperature-controlled receiving docks, and refrigerated and freezer storage units. It serves middle Tennessee, northern Alabama, and southern Kentucky, leveraging proximity to Interstates 24 and 65 for quick turnaround delivery, and offers a Cash & Carry program for local customers. Beyond distribution of beverages, labeled products, and produce as a Unipro Plus distributor, Palmer Foodservice provides sales consulting and pricing strategy support, and manages branded programs such as Little Italy and Broaster Chicken.

Its customer base includes grocery and convenience store delis, local restaurants, day cares, concession stands, water parks, and other foodservice operators. The company emphasizes product availability and inventory tracking for date-sensitive items.

Founded on principles of service, responsibility to the customer, and dedication to quality established by Jack Palmer Sr., the company's mission is to provide excellent customer service and premium quality food products at a fair price, a tradition it describes as a family commitment spanning over six decades.

about:
Palmetto Cabling Solutions operates from Rock Hill, South Carolina, where its office staff brings together more than 40 years of combined experience in communications infrastructure. The company deploys traveling project managers and technicians to serve clients across all 50 states.

The firm delivers a full range of low-voltage installation services, including structured cabling, fiber optic cable installation, WiFi deployment, and CATV/IPTV systems. It acts as a single-source contractor, handling engineering and design, material procurement, installation, and final testing of network systems for projects ranging from small offices to multi-story buildings.

Its customer base spans education, government, healthcare, industrial, commercial, and professional or collegiate stadium sectors. The company designs customized IP-based solutions for communications and security needs in each of these verticals.

Palmetto Cabling Solutions emphasizes quick response times and quality assurance as key differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that can take a project from concept through completion with a single point of accountability.

name: Panelmatic Electrical Solutions, LLC
old_description: From innovative solutions to exceptional quality, our dedication to customer satisfaction drives everything we do.
about:
Panelmatic Electrical Solutions was founded in 1966 in Brookfield Township, Ohio. The company designs and manufactures high-performance electrical and control systems for industrial, utility, renewable energy, and data center markets.

Its vertically integrated facilities handle design, manufacturing, wiring, and testing of precision-built control panels, fully integrated control houses, relay panels, power distribution centers, and medium- and low-voltage switchgear. Panelmatic also produces proprietary PanelSpan and PanelLock enclosure systems, offering a unified power and control ecosystem.

The company serves utilities, renewable energy developers, industrial manufacturers, and data center operators. Customers rely on Panelmatic for end-to-end project management, from engineering through commissioning, with dedicated project managers and digital tools to mitigate risk.

Panelmatic differentiates itself as the only manufacturer providing both PanelSpan and PanelLock enclosures, combined with in-house fabrication and testing that ensures consistency and compliance. Strategic investment has expanded its national footprint and engineering capacity, allowing faster delivery of field-tested systems.

name: Paperless Parts
old_description: Keep estimators working on high value activity, not busywork.
about:
Paperless Parts is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. The company traces its roots to 2001 when Jay Jacobs founded RAPID Manufacturing, which grew into the world's largest prototype sheet metal and second-largest prototype CNC machining business. Paperless Parts was later founded by Jacobs and Jason Ray to give other manufacturers access to the same technology tools that powered RAPID's success.

The company provides a cloud-based quoting and estimating platform built for custom manufacturers. Its software automates geometry-driven costing, detects manufacturability issues, supports multi-component nesting, and applies customizable pricing logic across processes including sheet metal fabrication, multi-axis CNC machining, Swiss screw machining, and additive manufacturing. The platform handles digital quoting, CRM, and real-time analytics, with customers collectively sending roughly 45,000 quotes per week and quoting over $35 billion in parts during 2025.

Paperless Parts serves job shops and contract manufacturers of all sizes, from one-person operations to facilities running $100 million contracts. Its customer base of more than 800 manufacturers spans industries such as aerospace, automotive, and medical, with documented deployments at companies including Quality Fabricators Inc., Jax Precision, Special Products & Mfg. (SPM), and KMM Group.

The founders built the platform because they believed software should adapt to a shop's workflow rather than force a one-size-fits-all process. The system is ITAR registered, hosted on AWS GovCloud with 100 percent U.S.-based support, and meets FedRAMP Moderate Equivalent and CMMC Level 2 assessment-ready standards, addressing the security requirements of defense and regulated-industry customers.

name: Paradise Power Company, Inc | PPC Solar
old_description: Paradise Power Company, Inc. (PPC Solar) was initially founded out of need for solar technology to sustain the off-grid lifestyle prevalent in northern New Mexico. With our roots starting in off-grid solar, PPC has over 45 years of expertise in the customization of off-grid and energy storage systems.
about:
Paradise Power Company, Inc. (PPC Solar) was founded in 1979 by Michael Weinman in Taos, New Mexico, to meet the demand for solar technology supporting the off-grid lifestyle common in northern New Mexico. The family-owned business passed to his son, Daniel Weinman, in 1993, and remains locally operated with headquarters in Taos and a fully staffed office and warehouse in Albuquerque.

The company provides turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction of solar photovoltaic, battery energy storage, and electric vehicle charging systems for residential, commercial, school, government, and utility clients. Since its founding, PPC has installed more than 30 megawatts of photovoltaic capacity and over 200 EV charging stations across New Mexico and Colorado, managing projects from design through long-term maintenance.

Customers include the Northern New Mexico School Employees Federal Credit Union in Santa Fe, Taos Mountain Builders, San Miguel County, Bartee Ranch, Angel Fire Family Dentistry, Eastern New Mexico University, and state agencies such as the New Mexico General Services Department and the New Mexico Department of Transportation. The firm also serves commercial clients like Taos Spa and Siemens.

PPC emphasizes its 45-plus years of continuous local presence, which has built strong relationships with inspectors, utilities, and vendors. The company backs its work with 10- and 25-year warranties and differentiates itself by keeping all project phases—design, procurement, installation, and service—under one roof.
